title: A focused Python workspace for mobile
summary: Compact runtime navigation, cohesive typography, RTL layout, clear actions and expandable editor settings.

changes.detail: Replaced oversized runtime buttons with one four-column selector and a compact close control. Added a unified green palette and sans-serif workspace typography.
Moved the editor ahead of secondary controls; retained settings, restart, files and input options in expandable sections. Added selected panel styling and a status badge.
Applied Arabic reading direction outside the LTR code editor and localized primary actions, status and file controls.
Removed the always-visible keyboard button; it appears when the visual viewport detects the keyboard.

validation.name: Validation
validation.detail: Focused lint, typecheck, Python interaction and history checks pending; real browser visual review and native device checks pending.
